name: Azaprocin
summary: Azaprocin is a drug which is an opioid analgesic with approximately ten times the potency of morphine, and a fast onset and short duration of action. It was discovered in 1963, but has never been marketed.

uses.text: It was discovered in 1963, but has never been marketed. One analogue, AP-237, has been used in China to treat the pain caused by cancer.

pharmacology.en: It acts on the mu-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine, with a fast onset and a short duration. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals and also slows breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 它作用於 μ 鴉片受體，與嗎啡標的相同，起效快而作用時間短。活化該受體會抑制疼痛訊號，同時也減緩呼吸。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它作用于 μ 鸦片受体，与吗啡标的相同，起效快而作用时间短。活化该受体会抑制疼痛信号，同时也减缓呼吸。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Strong opioids cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and can cause fatal overdose and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。強效鴉片類會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，並可能導致致命過量與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。强效鸦片类会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，并可能导致致命过量与成瘾。

fact.en: It was discovered in 1963 and never marketed, but one of its relatives, AP-237, went on to be used in China for cancer pain.
fact.zh: 它於 1963 年被發現，從未上市，但它的一個親屬 AP-237 後來在中國被用於癌症疼痛的治療。
fact.zhHans: 它于 1963 年被发现，从未上市，但它的一个亲属 AP-237 后来在中国被用于癌症疼痛的治疗。
